column1: # PEANUTS: the game steps by elapsed time (the same walk covers the same ground at 30 and 60 fps); its own limit is 60, so display pacing caps up to 60 are offered as experimental.

# PEANUTS: the game draws its 3D scene at a dynamic resolution between a floor (800x450 docked, 640x360 handheld) and 1600x900, and stays at the floor here; this option loads the floor from the maximum (main+0x8794, main+0x879c), so the scene stays at 1600x900 (the game note)

column4: Draws the 3D scene at the game's own 1600x900 instead of 800x450. Uses more GPU time: steady 60 fps on an Adreno 740, a dropped frame now and then in battles with large effects. Restart the game to apply.
